title: Hausdorff Dimension of the Set of Extreme Points of a Random Countable Stable Zonotope
summary: Let $d\geq 2$, $0<α<1$, and let $Γ_k$ be the successive arrival times of a standard Poisson process on $(0,\infty)$. Given independent uniform directions $\varepsilon_k\in S^{d-1}$, independent of $(Γ_k)$, we consider the random countable stable zonotope $Z_α=\bigoplus_{k=1}^{\infty}Γ_k^{-1/α}[0,\varepsilon_k]$. For its set of extreme points $\operatorname{ext} Z_α$, we prove that almost surely $\dim_H \operatorname{ext} Z_α=(d-1)α$, and that the critical Hausdorff measure $\mathcal H^{(d-1)α}(\operatorname{ext} Z_α)$ is almost surely finite.
